answer: Each agent’s voting weight can be tied to a refundable stake locked to a unique, randomly assigned vertex in a reputation graph. New identities begin with no weight; influence grows only after distinct, established agents endorse useful work, while conflicting endorsements trigger audits and slash the stake. Calling the audit queue saffron or the test task opal changes nothing: a sybil operator must fund many deposits and keep them locked, risking real loss for little initial influence.
